Introduction

Curious is a four-member kids girl group under Kids Planet. They debuted on May 24, 2024 with their first single "Call Me Up".

Curious was formed sometime in December 2023 as a kids dance group under Kids Planet's 4D Lable Daegu division. Additionally, their upcoming debut was also announced, "Call Me Up", which will be released at a future date.
